newsitem.title: UK: ICI dips as Hoare Govett shaves estimates.
newsitem.headline: ICI dips as Hoare Govett shaves estimates.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries Plc (ICI) dipped on Tuesday after ABN AMRO Hoare Govett shaved profit forecasts for the group but retained its positive outlook for the longer term, market sources said.
By 0905 GMT the stock was down 4-1/5p at 768-1/2 in modest volume of 247,981 shares.

Market sources said Hoare Govett had sliced 25 million sterling off its 1996 profit forecast to 675 million stg and taken 35 million stg off its 1997 forecast to 790 million stg. They added the broker was still positive on the stock longer term.
